marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Wind southwest 15 knots diminishing to light near midnight then
increasing to east 15 early Friday afternoon. Wind increasing to southeast 25
early Friday evening. Scattered flurries ending near noon Friday. Fog patches
forming Friday morning and dissipating Friday evening. Low tonight minus 2. High Friday plus 3. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Tonight and Friday.
marine.text:
Over open water seas 1 metre or less building to 1 to 2 Friday
evening.<br/>
